primaryCord.notes: Some pendants have colored threads introduced during the plying, producing a change of color down the length of the string. This is not a spike. The threads are camelid with vivid red.

cords.note: This cord is not attached to the primary cord, but is placed at the beginning.
Cord #34 may be a subsidiary of this cord starting at 1.5 cm.
